newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu leaves France for Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu leaves France for Morocco.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko, convalescing from prostate cancer surgery abroad while rebels hold an eastern region of his country, left France for Morocco on Monday to meet King Hassan, witnesses said.
His white private DC-8 jet took off from Nice airport shortly before 10 a.m. (0900 GMT).
The veteran president's son and spokesman, Mobutu Nzanga, told Reuters on Saturday that Mobutu would spend the week in Morocco and fly home to Zaire next Saturday.
Since he underwent prostate surgery in Switzerland on August 22, Mobutu has spent most of his time in his palatial French Riviera residence at Roquebrune-Cap Martin.
